use_case: AI quality inspection on processing lines: camera-based detection of foreign material, seal defects, and label and lot-code errors on 14 packaging lines at 5 plants
business_owner: Senior Vice President, Food Safety and Quality Assurance
vendor_or_model: AI vision inspection vendor (vendor-trained computer vision models; edge inference servers in each plant OT DMZ)
data_categories: Product and label images; lot codes from the MES; incidental images of workers' hands and arms (no audio)
human_in_the_loop: AI can only divert packs to a QA review bin; QA technicians decide every diverted pack; AI cannot release product and does not replace metal detection, X-ray, or manual visual inspection
applicable_laws: 9 CFR 417.4(a)(1) and (a)(3) if it becomes part of HACCP monitoring or changes the process; FMIA misbranding and 9 CFR 418.2 for label and lot-code errors that reach commerce; FTC Act Section 5 (vendor claims); worker-evaluation use prohibited by company decision
status: In production (14 lines at PLT-01, PLT-03, PLT-04, PLT-06, PLT-07); approved with conditions; bacon lines in bypass
food_safety_or_ccp_role: Supplemental only; not a CCP or HACCP monitoring device. PLT-03 cut manual inspection on 2 lines without reassessment (POAM-021)
bias_or_performance_testing_status: Local seeded-defect testing at PLT-03 only; vendor validation data for the other 4 plants (POAM-020)
monitoring: Seeded tests every shift; monthly detection and false-divert rates by plant, product, shift, and packaging film

use_case: Slicer yield optimization adjusting slice thickness within an approved range to hit target pack weight
human_in_the_loop: Operates within a range set in the MES; checkweighers reject underweight packs; line supervisors can switch it off
applicable_laws: Net quantity labeling rules via FMIA misbranding (checkweighers remain the control); FTC Act Section 5 (vendor claims)
bias_or_performance_testing_status: Vendor data only for pack weight accuracy by product (POAM-020)
monitoring: Daily checkweigher reject rates by line

use_case: Predictive maintenance for smokehouses, compressors, and slicers (advisory alerts)
vendor_or_model: Maintenance analytics service on the data lake (company-configured models)
data_categories: Equipment vibration, temperature, and run-time data
human_in_the_loop: Maintenance planners decide all work orders
bias_or_performance_testing_status: Model accuracy tracked against work orders

human_in_the_loop: Planners review and adjust every forecast
monitoring: Weekly forecast error by product family

use_case: Refrigeration energy optimization recommending compressor and evaporator setpoints
business_owner: Director of Refrigeration and Process Safety
consequential_decision_category: Safety/CI (only if closed-loop mode were enabled)
human_in_the_loop: Advisory mode only: refrigeration technicians decide and enter setpoint changes; closed-loop mode contractually and technically locked off
applicable_laws: 9 CFR 417.2(c)(4) (cold storage CCP context); PSM management of change (29 CFR 1910.119) context
council_review: Not reviewed (due 2026-11-30); re-tier to High before any closed-loop use
food_safety_or_ccp_role: Indirect: recommendations affect cold storage temperatures
bias_or_performance_testing_status: Not tested; vendor energy-savings claims only
monitoring: Monthly review of accepted recommendations and any temperature excursions

use_case: Worker safety camera analytics detecting missing protective equipment and near misses on 22 lines (aggregate dashboards)
data_categories: Video of production areas; aggregate counts
human_in_the_loop: Safety managers review aggregate trends; no alert names a worker; facial recognition and individual tracking disabled
applicable_laws: Federal workplace safety duties (context); state biometric privacy laws not analyzed because biometric identification is disabled (counsel review required before any change)
protected_characteristic_inputs: None used; images include all workers
bias_or_performance_testing_status: Detection accuracy reviewed by vendor; no fairness testing needed while no individual is identified
monitoring: Quarterly configuration audit that individual identification stays disabled (R-043)

use_case: Applicant screening and interview scheduling for hourly plant roles (ranks applicants and suggests interview slots)
data_categories: Applications; work history; availability; screening answers
human_in_the_loop: Recruiters review every application the model ranks low before any rejection; ranking is advisory
applicable_laws: Title VII of the Civil Rights Act (disparate impact remains a statutory theory; EEOC enforcement posture changed under EO 14281); Texas TRAIGA (HB 149) for PLT-08 hiring (intent-based prohibition on AI developed with intent to unlawfully discriminate); Colorado SB26-189 not applicable (no Colorado operations)
protected_characteristic_inputs: Model does not use protected characteristics as inputs; zip code and commute distance are inputs and can act as proxies
bias_or_performance_testing_status: Vendor adverse impact summary only; local selection rate analysis required before the 2027 hiring season (POAM-020)
monitoring: Monthly selection rate ratios by sex and race and ethnicity where self-reported

use_case: Enterprise generative AI assistant for office productivity (drafting, summarizing)
vendor_or_model: Enterprise generative AI service with no-training contract terms
data_categories: Internal and Confidential data; Restricted data prohibited
human_in_the_loop: Users review all outputs; not used for decisions about individuals
applicable_laws: FTC Act Section 5 if outputs reach customers; POL-04 4.8 and POL-05 4.8
monitoring: Quarterly review of blocked-content and data loss prevention events

use_case: Online store and consumer line chatbot (orders, product questions, complaint intake)
human_in_the_loop: Any complaint mentioning illness, injury, or foreign material is routed to a person and to FSQA consumer complaint review the same day
applicable_laws: FTC Act Section 5 (accuracy and disclosure of AI interaction); state privacy laws (generic); food safety complaint handling (company procedure)
food_safety_or_ccp_role: Complaint intake can signal a food safety problem
bias_or_performance_testing_status: Routing accuracy for food safety keywords tested on 200 historical complaints (96% routed); target 100%
monitoring: Weekly review of all complaints mentioning illness or foreign material
